name: Will a water softener affect my water pressure?

mainEntity.name: Will a water softener affect my water pressure?

acceptedAnswer.text: A properly sized and installed whole-house water softener should not significantly impact your home's water pressure. Modern water softeners are designed with high-flow valves that minimize pressure drops. However, if a system is undersized for your home's demand or if there are issues during installation, a slight pressure reduction could occur. We ensure the correct sizing and professional installation to maintain optimal water pressure throughout your plumbing system.
acceptedAnswer.description: A correctly sized and professionally installed water softener should not noticeably affect your home's water pressure.
